title: Germany’s LiveKomm elects new board to tackle ‘enormous challenges’
summary: German trade body LiveKomm has elected a new board during its general meeting in Leipzig this week. LiveMusikKommission e.V., the national association of venues and festivals, represents more than 830 music clubs, live venues, and festivals across over 100 cities and municipalities. New members include Andy Olschar (Association for Pop Culture in Bavaria), Marlies Resch (Zauberberg in Passau), and Zora Brändle (Clubkultur Baden-Württemberg). title: ‘World’s most remote festival’ sells out final edition in record time
summary: The world’s “most remote music festival”, Australia’s Birdsville Big Red Bash, sold out its final edition in record time as fans and organisers prepare to say goodbye after a dozen editions. Roughly 8,000 tickets flew out in under an hour for Queensland’s three-day outback camping festival, which organisers confirmed last month that 2027 would be the final instalment. This year’s event was cancelled after “once-in-a-generation” widespread flooding left the remote site underwater, organisers said.
